description: This file defines the LogWrapper class which implements a logging node interface, wrapping Android's native Log utility to enable customizable logging with chaining capabilities.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that implements LogNode to wrap Android's native Log utility, facilitating flexible and chained logging.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data after this node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs log messages to Android's native log, handling null messages and exceptions, and forwarding the log to the next node if available.
